run_densepose_training: run the DensePose training script with a config file and optional CLI overrides
run_densepose_evaluation: run the DensePose evaluation-only mode to test a model with test-time augmentation
setup_densepose_config: setup a Detectron2 config merged with DensePose settings from a YAML file
build_densepose_model: build a DensePose model from a frozen Detectron2 config using Trainer.build_model
train_densepose_model: train a DensePose model by creating a Trainer and calling train with resume support
